description: This file defines the PerformanceModuleController class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. The controller handles requests related to the performance module by redirecting to its default path. It extends the AbstractModuleController and relies on services to obtain configuration details.

classes.name: PerformanceModuleController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the performance module in the OrangeHRM application, providing a method to handle requests and redirect to the module's default page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to the performance module, retrieves the default path via a service, and redirects the user to that path.
